name: Poet Email Agent - Famous Author Born This Month

parameters.formDescription: Submit your email to receive a poem from a famous author born this month!

parameters.text:

Your task:
1. Identify a famous poet or author who was born in {{ $json.currentMonth }}.
2. Select one of their well-known poems (or a short excerpt if the poem is long).
3. Return your response in EXACTLY this format (no extra text outside this structure):

AUTHOR: [Author full name]
BORN: [Birth date, e.g. February 12, 1809]
POEM_TITLE: [Title of the poem]
POEM:
